title: GitHub - deepseek-ai/DeepInfer: DeepInfer: High-performance, large-scale inference framework for DeepSeek models
html:
DeepInfer is the high-performance inference framework that powers DeepSeek's large-scale production services. This open-source release provides offline inference with the core features needed for serving at scale.

Supported models:

  • DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash

Supported features:

  • Optimized kernels, model and sampler runtime
  • Parallelism: Attention DP / balanced CP, MoE EP + EPLB
  • DSpark and confidence-scheduled verification
  • SWA bounded replay
  • Asynchronous scheduling (zero-overhead batch scheduler)
  • Batch-invariant inference
  • Deterministic sampling
  • Structured outputs

Feature details and configuration

  • Optimized kernels: FlashMLA, DeepGEMM, DeepEP, TileKernels, DeepSelect, and custom TileLang kernels.
  • DSpark and confidence-scheduled verification: accelerate decoding with draft tokens and use confidence estimates to schedule verification. Set 
    DEEPINFER_ENABLE_MTP_VARLEN=1
    ; 
    DEEPINFER_USE_NEXTN_DECODE
    controls the maximum draft length (default: 5).
  • Decoder SWA bounded replay: reduce decoder prefill work by replaying only a bounded suffix. Set 
    DEEPINFER_YOCO_PREFILL_TRUNCATION_MODE=compact
    and 
    DEEPINFER_YOCO_PREFILL_KEEP_TOKENS=140
    for the default V4.1 settings; the retained suffix must cover the SWA window plus the maximum backtracking length.
  • Asynchronous scheduling: overlap CPU batch scheduling with device execution. Enabled by default.
  • Batch-invariant inference: keep model results identical across different batch compositions. Enable with 
    DEEPINFER_BATCH_INVARIANT=1
    (NVIDIA only).
  • Deterministic sampling: produce identical outputs for identical input tokens and sampling parameters. Set 
    DEEPINFER_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 DEEPINFER_ENABLE_MTP_VARLEN=0
    and pass a fixed 
    seq_seed
    to 
    SamplingParams
    (NVIDIA only).
  • Structured outputs: constrain generation to a regex, JSON schema, or EBNF grammar. Pass 
    so_args={"schema_type": ..., "schema": ...}
    to 
    SamplingParams
    ; see examples.

Supported hardware:

  • NVIDIA SM100 GPUs
  • Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs

Required for a complete inference service (not included in this release):

  • A KV cache system
  • VE/Prefill/Decode disaggregation (most required engine functionality is already implemented)
  • Load balancing across data-parallel replicas for both prefill and decode
  • Linux
  • GCC >= 13.0
  • Python 3.12
  • CUDA 13 (NVIDIA only)
  • CANN 9.2 (Ascend only)

Before building DeepInfer, please create and activate an empty Python 3.12 environment.

# Use `ascend` instead for the Ascend platform
# Keep it exported in the environment where you run DeepInfer
export DEEPINFER_ACCELERATOR=nvidia
./build.sh

The default checkpoint, 

deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
, is downloaded into the Hugging Face cache on the first run; set 
DEEPINFER_HF_MODEL_DIR=/path/to/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
to run from a local copy instead.

python examples/offline_inference.py

See examples for details.

Prefill Decode

Measured on 4 SM100 GPUs for prefill and 64 for decode — each within one scale-up domain. To reproduce the benchmarks, see run_sweep.sh.

See eval/README.md.

DeepInfer is released under the Apache License 2.0. See LICENSE for details.

DeepInfer was originally built primarily on vLLM, with additional inspiration from SGLang and TensorRT-LLM. We thank their developers.

markdown:
DeepInfer is the high-performance inference framework that powers DeepSeek's large-scale production services. This open-source release provides offline inference with the core features needed for serving at scale.

Supported models:

- DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash

Supported features:

- Optimized kernels, model and sampler runtime
- Parallelism: Attention DP / balanced CP, MoE EP + EPLB
- DSpark and confidence-scheduled verification
- SWA bounded replay
- Asynchronous scheduling (zero-overhead batch scheduler)
- Batch-invariant inference
- Deterministic sampling
- Structured outputs

## Feature details and configuration

- **Optimized kernels:** [FlashMLA](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/FlashMLA), [DeepGEMM](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepGEMM), [DeepEP](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepEP), [TileKernels](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/TileKernels), [DeepSelect](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSelect), and custom [TileLang kernels](/deepseek-ai/DeepInfer/blob/main/deepinfer/model_executor/layers/tilelang_ops).
- **DSpark and confidence-scheduled verification:** accelerate decoding with draft tokens and use confidence estimates to schedule verification. Set `DEEPINFER_ENABLE_MTP_VARLEN=1`; `DEEPINFER_USE_NEXTN_DECODE` controls the maximum draft length (default: 5).
- **Decoder SWA bounded replay:** reduce decoder prefill work by replaying only a bounded suffix. Set `DEEPINFER_YOCO_PREFILL_TRUNCATION_MODE=compact` and `DEEPINFER_YOCO_PREFILL_KEEP_TOKENS=140` for the default V4.1 settings; the retained suffix must cover the SWA window plus the maximum backtracking length.
- **Asynchronous scheduling:** overlap CPU batch scheduling with device execution. Enabled by default.
- **Batch-invariant inference:** keep model results identical across different batch compositions. Enable with `DEEPINFER_BATCH_INVARIANT=1` (NVIDIA only).
- **Deterministic sampling:** produce identical outputs for identical input tokens and sampling parameters. Set `DEEPINFER_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 DEEPINFER_ENABLE_MTP_VARLEN=0` and pass a fixed `seq_seed` to `SamplingParams` (NVIDIA only).
- **Structured outputs:** constrain generation to a regex, JSON schema, or EBNF grammar. Pass `so_args={"schema_type": ..., "schema": ...}` to `SamplingParams`; see [examples](/deepseek-ai/DeepInfer/blob/main/examples/_structured_output.py).

Supported hardware:

- NVIDIA SM100 GPUs
- Huawei Ascend 950 NPUs

Required for a complete inference service (not included in this release):

- A KV cache system
- VE/Prefill/Decode disaggregation (most required engine functionality is already implemented)
- Load balancing across data-parallel replicas for both prefill and decode

- Linux
- GCC >= 13.0
- Python 3.12
- CUDA 13 (NVIDIA only)
- CANN 9.2 (Ascend only)

Before building DeepInfer, please create and activate an empty Python 3.12 environment.

```
# Use `ascend` instead for the Ascend platform
# Keep it exported in the environment where you run DeepInfer
export DEEPINFER_ACCELERATOR=nvidia
./build.sh
```
The default checkpoint, [`deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`](https://huggingface.co/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017), is
downloaded into the Hugging Face cache on the first run; set `DEEPINFER_HF_MODEL_DIR=/path/to/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017` to
run from a local copy instead.

`python examples/offline_inference.py`
See [examples](/deepseek-ai/DeepInfer/blob/main/examples/README.md) for details.

| Prefill | Decode | 
|---|---|

Measured on 4 SM100 GPUs for prefill and 64 for decode — each within one scale-up domain. To reproduce the benchmarks, see [run\_sweep.sh](/deepseek-ai/DeepInfer/blob/main/examples/sweep/run_sweep.sh).

See [eval/README.md](/deepseek-ai/DeepInfer/blob/main/eval/README.md).

DeepInfer is released under the Apache License 2.0. See [LICENSE](/deepseek-ai/DeepInfer/blob/main/LICENSE) for details.

DeepInfer was originally built primarily on [vLLM](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm), with additional inspiration from [SGLang](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang) and [TensorRT-LLM](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM). We thank their developers.

summary_zh: DeepInfer 是支撑 DeepSeek 线上大规模服务的推理框架，本次开源的是离线推理部分，目前只支持 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash。核心特性包括 FlashMLA、DeepGEMM、DeepEP 等优化内核，Attention DP/CP 与 MoE 专家并行，带置信度调度验证的草稿解码（默认最多 5 个草稿 token），零开销异步批调度、批不变推理、确定性采样和正则/JSON Schema 结构化输出。硬件支持英伟达 SM100 GPU 和华为昇腾 950 NPU，需 Linux、GCC 13+、Python 3.12、CUDA 13 或 CANN 9.2 从源码构建。完整线上服务所需的 KV 缓存系统、Prefill/Decode 分离和多副本负载均衡未包含在本次发布中。

html_zh:
DeepInfer 是高性能推理框架，为 DeepSeek 的大规模生产服务提供支持。此开源版本提供离线推理以及大规模服务所需的核心功能。

支持型号：

  • DeepSeek-V4.1-闪存

支持的功能：

  • 优化的内核、模型和采样器运行时
  • 并行性：Attention DP/balanced CP、MoE EP + EPLB
  • DSpark 和置信计划验证
  • SWA 有界重播
  • 异步调度（零开销批量调度程序）
  • 批次不变推理
  • 确定性采样
  • 结构化输出

功能细节和配置

  • 优化内核： FlashMLA 、 DeepGEMM 、 DeepEP 、 TileKernels 、 DeepSelect和自定义TileLang 内核。
  • DSpark 和置信度计划验证：使用草稿令牌加速解码并使用置信度估计来安排验证。放
    DEEPINFER_ENABLE_MTP_VARLEN=1
    ;
     DEEPINFER_USE_NEXTN_DECODE
    控制最大拔模长度（默认值：5）。
  • 解码器 SWA 有界重播：通过仅重播有界后缀来减少解码器预填充工作。放
    DEEPINFER_YOCO_PREFILL_TRUNCATION_MODE=紧凑
    和
    DEEPINFER_YOCO_PREFILL_KEEP_TOKENS=140
    默认 V4.1 设置；保留的后缀必须覆盖 SWA 窗口加上最大回溯长度。
  • 异步调度：CPU批量调度与设备执行重叠。默认启用。
  • 批次不变推理：在不同批次组合中保持模型结果相同。启用与
    DEEPINFER_BATCH_INVARIANT=1
    （仅限 NVIDIA）。
  • 确定性采样：对于相同的输入标记和采样参数产生相同的输出。放
    DEEPINFER_BATCH_INVARIANT=1 DEEPINFER_ENABLE_MTP_VARLEN=0
    并通过一个固定的
    序列种子
    到
    采样参数
    （仅限 NVIDIA）。
  • 结构化输出：将生成限制为正则表达式、JSON 模式或 EBNF 语法。经过
    so_args={"schema_type": ..., "schema": ...}
    到
    采样参数
    ;参见示例。

支持的硬件：

  • NVIDIA SM100 GPU
  • 华为Ascend 950 NPU

完整推理服务所需（不包含在此版本中）：

  • KV缓存系统
  • VE/预填充/解码分解（最需要的引擎功能已经实现）
  • 预填充和解码的数据并行副本之间的负载平衡
  • Linux
  • 海湾合作委员会 >= 13.0
  • Python 3.12
  • CUDA 13（仅限 NVIDIA）
  • CANN 9.2（仅限提升）

在构建 DeepInfer 之前，请创建并激活一个空的 Python 3.12 环境。

# Use `ascend` instead for the Ascend platform
# Keep it exported in the environment where you run DeepInfer
export DEEPINFER_ACCELERATOR=nvidia
./build.sh

默认检查点，

deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
，在第一次运行时下载到 Hugging Face 缓存中；放
DEEPINFER_HF_MODEL_DIR=/path/to/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017
从本地副本运行。

python examples/offline_inference.py

详细信息请参见示例。

预填充 解码

在 4 个用于预填充的 SM100 GPU 和 64 个用于解码的 SM100 GPU 上进行测量 — 每个 GPU 都在一个扩展域内。要重现基准测试，请参阅run_sweep.sh 。

请参阅eval/README.md 。

DeepInfer 在 Apache License 2.0 下发布。有关详细信息，请参阅许可证。

DeepInfer 最初主要基于vLLM构建，并受到SGLang和TensorRT-LLM的额外启发。我们感谢他们的开发者。
